dunnhumby.verdict: The price-aware model did NOT clearly beat the best price-blind baseline on the days the price moved in this data set.

note: Real shoppers, not our simulated ones. The data sets are not Philippine unless the file is yours; they test the method. WAPE is total absolute error over total units on days the model has not seen.
source: Dunnhumby The Complete Journey (public data set; 150 ordinary products, last 30% of each history as the test). Aggregated results only.
